about: <data root>/data-format.json, { "writtenBy": "<release>", "format": <integer> }: the newest release that wrote the data folder. Node never writes it (src/data-format.mjs only reads it); 2.0 does, and 1.x reads it to warn that a newer SpawnLoft used the folder. A warning, never a refusal. test/contracts-files.test.mjs runs every case through readDataFormat and dataFormatWarning.

rules.read: a BOM is ignored; anything that is not a JSON object reads as no marker; unknown fields are kept and ignored.
rules.warn: only when writtenBy names a newer major release than the reader, or format is an integer above the reader's DATA_FORMAT (1). DATA_FORMAT does not change during the port.
rules.writer: for the Rust side: write it as Node writes every other small JSON file, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) and a newline, writtenBy first.
